name: parser
argv: set -e; source /workspace/work/validation/sdk/cangjie/envsetup.sh; cjc --version; cjfmt -f tests/editing/src/review_regressions.cj -o /workspace/work/editing-tests/review-round1/formatted/review_regressions.cj; cjfmt -f tests/editing/src/main.cj -o /workspace/work/editing-tests/review-round1/formatted/main.cj

name: build
argv: set -e; source /workspace/work/validation/sdk/cangjie/envsetup.sh; export CANGJIE_STDX_PATH=/workspace/work/linux-build-recon/stdx-env; export CJTUI_UCD_ARCHIVE=/workspace/work/validation/replay-dependencies/UCD-17.0.0.zip; exec cjpm build

name: E120-I01
argv:
source /workspace/work/validation/sdk/cangjie/envsetup.sh
export CANGJIE_STDX_PATH=/workspace/work/linux-build-recon/stdx-env
export CJTUI_UCD_ARCHIVE=/workspace/work/validation/replay-dependencies/UCD-17.0.0.zip
export TERM=dumb COLORTERM= CJTUI_EDITING_REVIEW_CASE=E120-I01
exec timeout 90s ./target/release/bin/main </dev/null
